report: Reviewed the complete claim, the sole ordinary implementation association in sage_ir::check::operator, and the complete sole associated TODO test sage_meta::todo::types_operators_lazy_control_flow. Both && and || must remain explicit lazy operations, preserve conditional RHS evaluation, and avoid eager trait-method dispatch. Source inspection shows check_binary_operator dispatches And/Or directly to check_lazy_boolean before operator-method lookup; that helper requires boolean operands and returns TyExprData::Binary retaining the operation and both operand pointers. operator_method_for also maps both operators to None. This establishes preserved operator representation and bypass of eager resolved calls at this checking stage, not runtime short-circuit execution. The associated test is explicitly empty TODO evidence, with no behavioral assertions. Its comment specifically defers direct checks of both lazy node kinds and conditional RHS semantics; satisfying it requires substantive tests distinguishing And/Or and observing skipped versus evaluated RHS paths. Thus a regression making RHS evaluation eager would not be caught by this associated test, and conditional execution verification remains deferred, not claimed complete. The explicit TODO adequately accounts for that gap; no edits requested. Independently verified exact byte equality of current operator.rs and representation_spec.rs with the historical source snapshots. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current claim, metadata, and actual body; did not treat historical approval or empty test success as proof. No extra source helper dependency was needed for this limited assessment. Executed review start and byte comparison, and submitting this report with review record; no behavioral tests or cargo build executed by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 functional tests and root build are separate baseline execution evidence, not reviewer execution.
